physicalNotes: Radius 1.008 Jupiter radii from Bernabò et al. 2024 (2024AJ....168..273B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..273B/abstract): 72,063.9 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 1.04 Jupiter masses (Bernabò et al. 2024, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2024AJ....168..273B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..273B/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
